minor_characters.name: Galen
minor_characters.appearances_summary: Castle physician who examines Xander after the Portal battle, identifies silver-poisoning, prescribes rest, and is named once at the end of the healing scene.
minor_characters.reason_removable: His role can remain as an unnamed healer/doctor without changing any plot beats or character arcs, so the specific named character adds no necessary weight.

subplots.name: Heather’s wild taxi chase after a possibly tailing car
subplots.reason_removable: The chase provides color and shows Heather’s personality but has no bearing on Miriam’s abduction, choices, or later relationships.

subplots.name: Miriam’s sheet-ambush hallway caper (the ‘badger’ ruse) before stumbling into Xander’s room
subplots.reason_removable: This comedic escape beat can be skipped to move directly from Miriam waking to her private encounter with Xander without altering the plot or their dynamic.

subplots.name: Overheard war-news about northern raiders in the borderlands
subplots.reason_removable: The brief exposition about raids foreshadows series-level conflict but doesn’t affect Book 1’s decisions, stakes, or outcomes.

subplots.name: Aggressive sheep demonstration on the lawn
subplots.reason_removable: This worldbuilding vignette adds local color but neither advances the Portal visit nor affects any character arc.

subplots.name: Alex’s flirtatious farewell and horse ‘stallions’ banter at departure
subplots.reason_removable: The cameo provides light closure for a side character but cutting it keeps end-focus on Miriam, Xander, and the planned journey without changing the ending configuration.

digressions.topic: Sneak peek of Book 2 (Realms of the Dragons)
digressions.reason_removable: It is promotional sequel material unrelated to the completed arc of Book 1.

digressions.topic: Promotional backmatter ads for other series
digressions.reason_removable: Marketing copy after the story ends can be dropped without affecting plot or theme.

digressions.topic: Map tour and geography overview of the five kingdoms
digressions.reason_removable: The brief map exposition is optional worldbuilding that doesn’t change the decision to depart for Xander’s domain or the book’s closing image.
